# GLPX Studio

> GLPX Studio is a branding and headshot photography studio in Orlando, Florida, founded by photographer Gerson Lopez. It photographs founders, realtors, artists, executives and corporate teams, in English or Spanish, in rented studios in Orlando or on location across Central Florida.

- Founder and photographer: Gerson Lopez (8+ years photographing people; album cover work for Alex Rose and Anuel AA)
- Services: branding photography, headshots, corporate team headshots, editorial and music photography, corporate event photography, commercial photography, video
- Languages: English and Spanish (sessions fully bilingual)
- Service area: Orlando, Downtown Orlando, Winter Park, Lake Nona, Baldwin Park, Thornton Park, Dr. Phillips, Windermere, Winter Garden, Kissimmee, Celebration, Altamonte Springs, Lake Mary, Sanford, Oviedo and the rest of Central Florida
- Pricing: custom quote for every shoot, sent within 24 hours of a free strategy call
- Packages: Starter Branding (2 hours, 2 outfits, 10 edited images), Signature Branding (3 hours, 4 outfits, 15 edited images), Half Day (up to 5 hours), Full Day (up to 10 hours)
- Process: free strategy call, shoot plan, guided shoot day, edited images delivered in 2 to 3 weeks; a 50% deposit holds the date
- Reviews: 5.0 stars on Google
- Contact: (407) 534-7581 (call or text), glpxstudio@gmail.com, Instagram @glpxstudio

## Services

- [Branding photography](https://www.glpxstudio.com/branding.html): planned branding shoots with outfits, locations and a shot list for websites, LinkedIn and Instagram
- [Headshots](https://www.glpxstudio.com/headshots.html): guided headshots for actors, lawyers, doctors, realtors and executives
- [Corporate team headshots](https://www.glpxstudio.com/corporate-headshots-orlando.html): matching headshots for teams and offices, on site or in studio
- [Editorial and music](https://www.glpxstudio.com/editorial.html): album covers, press kits, beauty and fashion stories
- [Corporate event photography](https://www.glpxstudio.com/corporate-event-photography-orlando.html): conferences, launches and company parties, in English and Spanish
- [Commercial photography](https://www.glpxstudio.com/commercial-photography-orlando.html): product, team and brand imagery for businesses
- [Video](https://www.glpxstudio.com/videography-orlando.html): video for businesses and brands
